name: Indus Hospital
mission:
Friends of Indus Hospital, Inc (FOIH) is a US-based 501(c)(3) registered charity. We strive to create awareness about the healthcare needs of underprivileged patients and raise funds to provide them with equitable care. By supporting healthcare efforts in Pakistan, FOIH is helping to ensure that vulnerable individuals have access to the healthcare they need, regardless of financial or other barriers.
Through annual fundraising initiatives, community events, and awareness drives, we seek to mobilize a strong tradition of community giving and a shared commitment to changing the paradigm of healthcare delivery in Pakistan.
FOIH is an initiative taken by Americans of Pakistani origin expatriates and supported by a wider community across the USA.
All donations given to FOIH are eligible for tax deduction under US law.

strengths_deep_dive: Friends of Indus Hospital demonstrates high financial efficiency by maintaining an <cite id="3">84.6% program expense Ratio</cite> in FY2024 [3]. rich_narrative.summary: Friends of Indus Hospital supports free, high-quality medical services to underserved patients in Pakistan [3]. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $14,690,150</cite> to deliver healthcare interventions including prosthetic limbs, neonatal care, and safe birth programs [3]. The charity maintains a strong financial profile with a <cite id="3">Program expense ratio of 84.6%</cite>, directing the vast majority of its spending to medical care [3]. This efficiency beats the 75% industry standard, though it rests slightly below the peer median of 87.7% for global health organizations [3]. Overall institutional health is reflected in its <cite id="2">87/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid [2]. As a Zakat-eligible charity, it provides a transparent vehicle for Muslim donors seeking high-urgency healthcare impact in Pakistan [1].
